recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photograph on the right and a minimalist white field on the left. A sharp, elongated red triangle and a bisected black-and-white circle act as geometric bridges between the two halves.
coreVisualRelationships: The red triangle points from the white void into the photographic subject's torso.
The bisected circle mirrors the vertical split of the overall canvas.
The high-contrast grain of the photo contrasts with the flat, solid geometric shapes.
Typography is anchored to the top left, overlapping the geometric elements.
coreInvariants: Vertical division of the frame at approximately 40/60 ratio.
High-contrast, near-threshold black and white photography.
Presence of a single primary accent color (Red).
Geometric shapes with clean, hard edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Human figure occupies the right 60% of the frame, cropped at the waist and top of head, appearing in a dynamic, slightly hunched pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red triangle serves as the primary focal point, drawing the eye from the left margin toward the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, follows the red triangle's point into the figure, then moves down the splashing water textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left 40% is predominantly white negative space, providing a resting area for the eye and a clean background for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones in the photography; high saturation in the single red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in a high-contrast, elegant serif with italicized flow.
Secondary text in a heavy, condensed block sans-serif inside a solid black bar.
Initial letter of the name is significantly oversized (drop-cap style).
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' is enlarged to roughly 4x the height of the following lowercase letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, organic serif paired with a rigid, industrial sans-serif for structural contrast.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular bar for secondary text

avoid: Modernist geometric sans-serifs for the main name
Soft or rounded corners on the geometric shapes

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the primary name style.
Matches the heavy, industrial feel of the secondary text bar.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. Right side: high-contrast black and white photo of a person in a shower or rain, very grainy, deep blacks. Left side: solid white. Overlay a long red triangle pointing right and a circle that is white on top and black on bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in a large, elegant serif font at the top left, with the first letter significantly larger. Below it, place a black horizontal bar containing the secondary title in a white, bold, condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the photography high-contrast B&W with grain?
Does the red triangle point toward the figure?
Is the circle bisected horizontally into black and white?

adjustableVariables: Angle and length of the red triangle
Scale of the oversized initial letter
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the photographic subject is a generic figure
Do not replicate the 'Compact Disc' logo in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and white values in the photo.
Verify the red triangle is the only source of color.
Ensure the text is legible against the white background.
Confirm the vertical split is clean and sharp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen + High-Contrast Grainy Portrait + Constructivist Geometry + Serif/Sans-Serif Typographic Pairing
